mentions.name: Human Kit
mentions.description: A headless UI library for Svelte, currently in beta, built to cover use cases that existing options didn't fit.
mentions.problem: Existing Svelte UI library options didn't fit the author's use case.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on [https://ui.human-kit.com/](https://ui.human-kit.com/) a (still in beta) headless UI library for Svelte. I couldn't find any option that fit my use case, so I decided to build my own and share it to the world.
mentions.author: agustinxix
